decisive_items: Finger extensor tendons at the right third and left second and fourth MCP joints: focal thickening, hypoechoic with loss of fibrillar pattern; power Doppler showed increased flow; mild synovitis in the right second MCP joint
response.rationale: High-titer anti-CCP and RF, symmetric small-joint synovitis, and tenosynovitis strongly favor RA despite entheseal-like findings; enthesitis is secondary or overlap but less specific.

rejected.why: Tendinosis alone cannot explain polyarthritis, elevated inflammatory markers, and highly positive anti-CCP.
Enthesitis is present but the clinical picture with anti-CCP and MCP/MTP synovitis is more consistent with RA.
